facts.text: Snow left Summer Rim (7,080 ft) 20 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Summer Rim
evidence.detail: left April 4; earlier seasons: May 2 (2023), April 19 (2024), April 24 (2025)

facts.text: At Summer Rim (7,080 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 0.9 in, the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026).

evidence.name: Summer Rim
evidence.detail: 0.9 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 12.3 in (2023), 6.1 in (2024), 13.4 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 7 and April 23, carried from the melt-out date at Summer Rim (7,080 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Summer Rim
evidence.detail: melted out April 4, 276 ft above the pass; points to March 7 to April 23
